_comment: Best-effort ground truth for OWASP Juice Shop. Juice Shop's flaw set and routes vary by version; corpus_runner reports missed/unexpected AND a coverage manifest so you can refine path_keys/expected for your build. Juice Shop is a heavy Angular SPA — run with --crawl --browser so JS-discovered routes are tested; many challenges are client-side/stateful and out of scope for the runtime oracles. Treat this as a starting template, not a fixed denominator.
